name: qa_wave
title: OS-FINALQA FQA-5b: Wave, the unit-pending rows QA-WAV-009..023 (the Shift list, the point edits, CHOP EVEN / ADD / DEL / ZC / AUTO, the WAVETABLE and GRANULAR views, F6 preview held, zoom): instrument 1 of t-v16; instrument 1's mode is changed and the finally run reloads t-v16

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)
(the cpu counters are since boot or since this reset: a scenario that checks underruns / over-budget starts from zero)
a pad on the Sample edit screen picks the instrument: 1
the sample of instrument 1 is bound (else this scenario has nothing to edit)

steps.say: OS-FINALQA FQA-5b: the Wave rows of docs/qa/catalogue/wave.md that keys and the console reach (QA-WAV-009..023; 008 needs a /WTABLE file: qa_instrument.json). Instrument 1 of t-v16 is edited and its mode changed; the finally run reloads t-v16. The shots are the check of the screen's words; the waveform lane is drawn on the unit only. ZC is a view switch: a run starts with it ON after a boot, a former run may leave it OFF

steps.note: QA-WAV-009: Shift + F1 opens the list
QA-WAV-009: the list's key row: SELECT on F1, BACK on F8; the dialog line says the same
QA-WAV-009: F8 BACK closes it, nothing changed

steps.say: QA-WAV-010 / 011 / 012: F3 picks LOOP END, F4 picks END (the highlighted row), F5 turns ZC off (the header reads ZC OFF)

steps.note: QA-WAV-010: the LOOP END row is highlighted
QA-WAV-011: the END row is highlighted
QA-WAV-012: the header reads ZC OFF after the press (ON before it)

steps.say: QA-WAV-013: hold F6 PREVIEW: the instrument sounds while the key is down (the voice is checked here, the sound by ear)

steps.note: QA-WAV-013: a voice while F6 is down (by ear: the sound of the instrument)

steps.say: QA-WAV-014: F7 ZOOM- widens the window, Up zooms in again around the picked point

steps.note: QA-WAV-014: the window is wider (the lane is drawn on the unit)
Up zooms in around the picked point

steps.say: QA-WAV-015 / 016: END is picked (F4): the encoder -5 moves it 5 frames (ZC off): END 195 of 200 in the simulator's fixture; F8 UNDO puts it back, Shift + F8 redoes it

steps.note: QA-WAV-015: END 5 frames before the edit; the loop points follow
QA-WAV-016: the screen as before the edit
QA-WAV-016: Shift + F8 redoes the point edit
(and UNDO again: the point is back where it was)

steps.say: QA-WAV-017 / 019 / 020 / 021: the CHOP page: F2 EVEN cuts 16 equal slices (BEAT SLICE), F4 ADD puts one at the middle, F5 DEL removes the selected one, F3 ZC snaps the slice starts

steps.note: QA-WAV-017: MODE BEAT SLICE, SLICES 16, 16 lit pads
QA-WAV-019: SLICES 17, the new slice selected
QA-WAV-020: SLICES 16 again

steps.say: QA-WAV-029 (OS-UXF-SMP item 3c): Shift + F4 TO PAT writes slice 1..16 as notes 24..39 on consecutive steps of the Pattern cursor's track, from its row; F8 UNDO takes them all back in one

steps.note: QA-WAV-029: the strip says SLICES TO PAT
QA-WAV-029: one undo unit (the Pattern is as before)
QA-WAV-021: the header's ZC switch (the same as the WAVE page's F5)
(ZC back)

steps.say: QA-WAV-018: F1 AUTO runs the slicer as a job: the strip shows the slicing, then one slice per hit (the simulator has no hits; a real sample has them); one F8 UNDO takes it back

steps.note: QA-WAV-018: the job's strip message
QA-WAV-018: one slice per detected hit
QA-WAV-018: one undo unit: the 16 EVEN slices come back

steps.say: QA-WAV-022: the WAVETABLE view: Shift + F1, the list's cursor clamps at the top (up 8), six Down are WAVETABLE, F1 picks it

steps.note: QA-WAV-022: the keys POSITION WINDOW - - - PREVIEW ZOOM- UNDO
QA-WAV-022: F7 ZOOM- (wavetable view)
QA-WAV-022: F8 UNDO

steps.say: QA-WAV-023: the GRANULAR view (one Down from WAVETABLE): F2 LENGTH picked, the encoder -1 edits it, F8 UNDO undoes it; F5 does nothing

steps.note: QA-WAV-023: F5 is blank
QA-WAV-023: the keys POSITION LENGTH SHAPE LOOP - PREVIEW ZOOM- UNDO
QA-WAV-023: the encoder's edit is undone
